beforeSubmitPrompt.command: if [ -z "$NEBULA_AGENT_ID" ] || [ -z "$NEBULA_API_URL" ]; then printf '{"continue": true}\n'; exit 0; fi; curl -sS -m 3 -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEBULA_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @- "$NEBULA_API_URL/api/hooks/cursor?agentId=$NEBULA_AGENT_ID&hookEvent=UserPromptSubmit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{"continue": true}\n'

stop.command: if [ -z "$NEBULA_AGENT_ID" ] || [ -z "$NEBULA_API_URL" ]; then printf '{"continue": true}\n'; exit 0; fi; curl -sS -m 3 -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEBULA_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @- "$NEBULA_API_URL/api/hooks/cursor?agentId=$NEBULA_AGENT_ID&hookEvent=Stop" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{"continue": true}\n'

subagentStart.command: if [ -z "$NEBULA_AGENT_ID" ] || [ -z "$NEBULA_API_URL" ]; then printf '{"continue": true}\n'; exit 0; fi; curl -sS -m 3 -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $NEBULA_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @- "$NEBULA_API_URL/api/hooks/cursor?agentId=$NEBULA_AGENT_ID&hookEvent=SubagentStart" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{"continue": true}\n'
